_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0% of 72 windows moving ±2+ points and a 0-for-12 directional call record, this is a textbook coil — HOLD with conviction is the statistically honest default and a skilled, graded call that wins when the score holds.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split — both agree current phase is Denial and regime is RISK_OFF, but analyst's forward call of Disbelief (+2 rungs) is illegal under the ±1 rule and is overridden; narrative implies an imminent bullish reversal from the August analog while analyst explicitly warns forced direction calls fail in coils.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows reverse above 60 with DXY breaking below 98 and gold strength moderating below 85 — signals risk-on rotation toward Hope (up-leg)
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC funding drops below 0.003% with exchange netflow spiking above 90 and VIX breaking 16 — signals flush toward Panic (down-leg)
